verses.text: Ayik ix lajwi yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús, ix yalanxi t'a heb' sk'ayb'um:

--Eyojtak, chab'ejokxo tz'och q'uinh yik sko naankoti tas aj yelnakkot heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto. Ha in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ata' ol in ak'jokoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ol in kulusanchamok, xchi t'a heb'.
Axo heb' winh sat sakerdote, heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh t'a spat winhaj Caifás, winh sat sakerdote.
Ata' ix laj yal heb' winh tas ol yutok heb' winh yak'anoch es t'a yib'anh Jesús, yik syamchaj yuj heb' winh, smilancham heb' winh.
Palta ix yalan heb' winh: --Max yal-laj ko yaman winh t'a yol q'uinh tik, yujto ay smay ol k'e somnaj heb' anima skot yowal t'ayonh yuj winh, xchi heb' winh.
Ix k'och Jesús t'a Betania. Ix ochk'och t'a yol spat winhaj Simón. Ha t'a yik yalanhtaxo, penaay winh yuj jun yab'il skuchan lepra.

Ayik k'ojanem Jesús swa'i, ix k'och jun ix ix t'ay. Yet'nak jun limeta ix sb'onak yet' jun k'een skuch alabastro. B'ut'ut'i k'een t'a jun suk'uq'ui sjab' te karo stojol. Ix stob'ank'e jun chi' ix t'a sjolom Jesús.
Axo ix yilan jun chi' heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi', ix kot yowal heb' t'a ix. Ix laj yalank'e heb': --¿Tas yuj nab'anhej tz'ixtax jun tik?
Ha jun suk'uq'ui sjab' tik, te karo stojol. Oktom ix chonhchaji, haxo stojol chi' tz'ak'ji t'a heb' meb'a', xchi heb'.
Axo ix yab'an juntzanh chi' Jesús, ix yalan t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj tze tzuntzej ix? Ha jun sk'ulej ix tik t'ayin, wach' toni.
Ha heb' meb'a' tzeyal chi', aynhejek' heb' eyet'ok. Palta a inxo tik, manh masanilok tiempo ay in ek' eyet'ok.
Ayokto ix yak'anoch jun suk'uq'ui sjab' tik ix t'a in niwanil tik, yik wach' listaxo waj yet' in mukil.
Wal yel swal t'ayex, yalnhej b'ajtil ol aljokel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol aljok pax yab'ixal tas ix sk'ulej ix tik, yik ol najokkot ix, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ay jun winh t'a skal heb' winh slajchawanhil, haton winhaj Judas aj Queriot, ix b'at lolon winh yet' heb' winh sat sakerdote.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Tato swak'och Jesús t'a yol he k'ab', ¿jantak tzin he tupu'? xchi winh. Yuj chi', 30 plata tumin ix ak'ji t'a winh yuj heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix sayan modo winh tas ol yutok yak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' heb'.

Ha t'a jun sb'ab'el k'ual q'uinh swaji ixim pan malaj yich ayb'at t'a skal, ix k'och heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús t'ay, ix sk'anb'an heb': --¿B'ajtil a gana sko b'o b'aj ol onh waok yik sko naankoti tas aj yelnakkot heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto? xchi heb' t'ay.

--Ixikek t'a chonhab'. Ay jun winh b'aj ol ex k'och t'a spat. Icha tik ol eyal t'a winh: Xchikot ko k'ayb'umal to kenxonhej tiempo ayeq'ui. Yuj chi' syala' to t'a a pat tik ol wa ket' a onh sk'ayb'um onh tik, yik sko nakot yet'ok tas aj yelnakkot heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto, xchi. Icha chi' tzeyutej eyalan t'a winh, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Yuj chi', ix b'at heb' sk'ayb'um chi' sb'o icha ix yal chi'. Ix sb'oan heb' tas ol schi heb' t'a q'uinh chi'.
Axo t'a k'ik'b'alil, ix k'och Jesús chi' wael yet' heb' sk'ayb'um chi'.
Ayik wan swa yet' heb', ix yalani: --Wal yel swal t'ayex, ay jun t'a ko kal tik ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, xchi t'a heb'.
Ix laj och heb' ilk'olal yab'an jun chi'. Yuj chi', junjun heb' ix och ijan sk'anb'an yab' t'ay: --Mamin, ¿tom a in? xchi junjun heb' t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --Ha jun wan swa wet' t'a jun uk'ab' ayek' t'a ko nanhal tik, a ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.

Ha in tik, Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, palta yowalil ol in chamok, icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a Slolonel Dios. Palta te chuk yik jun ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel chi'. Oktom maj uneajlaj. Tato icha chi', más wach' yiko', xchi t'a heb'.
Axo winhaj Judas, winh ol ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel chi', ix alan t'ay: --Ach in k'ayb'umal, ¿tom a in? xchi winh. --Ha ach toni, xchi t'a winh.

Ayik wan swa yet' heb' sk'ayb'um chi', ix yik'anchaanh ixim pan. Ix yak'an yuj diosal yuj ixim. Ix lajwinhej chi', ix xepanb'at ixim, ix yak'an t'a heb' sk'ayb'um. --Waanhek. Haton in niwanil tik, xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix syaman jun waso ayem yal sat uwa t'a yool. Ix yak'an yuj diosal t'a Dios yuj. Ix yak'anpax t'a heb'. --Mol uk'ejek jun tik he masanil.
Yujto haton jun tik in chiq'uil. Yuj in chiq'uil tik ol elk'och jun strato Dios eyet'ok. Ol elkan in chiq'uil tik, yik wach' tzijtum mach ol ak'jok lajwok smul yuj.
Palta swalkan t'ayex tiknaik to manhxa b'aj ol wuk' yal sat te' uwa, masanto t'a jun k'u ol wuk'xi eyet'ok, ayik ol wach' och ko Mam Dios Yajalil, xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi sb'itan jun b'it heb' t'a Dios, ix elta heb'. Ix b'at heb' t'a tzalan Oliwo.

Ata' ix yal Jesús t'a heb': --Masanil ex tik ol ex somchajkanel wuuj t'a jun ak'wal tik. Yujto tz'ib'yajkan t'a Slolonel Dios: Ol in milcham winh tanhwum kalnel. Axo nok' kalnel chi', ol saklemkanb'at nok', xchi.
Palta haxo yik ol in pitzwokxi, ol in b'ab'laj k'och eyuuj t'a Galilea, xchi t'a heb'.
Axo winhaj Pedro ix alan t'ay: --Wach'chom ol somchajkanel spensar heb' t'ayach, palta a in tik, malaj b'ak'uinh ol in somchajelok, xchi winh.
--Wal yel swal t'ayach, ha t'a jun ak'wal tik, ayik manto ok' nok' kaxlanh, oxel ol ik'el t'a ib'anh ol alani to manh in ojtakok, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
--Wach'chom ol in miljokcham et'ok, palta manh ol wala' to manh ach wojtakok, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'ay. Anhejtona' icha chi' ix laj yal heb' sk'ayb'um chi' smasanil.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och Jesús yet' heb' sk'ayb'um t'a Getsemaní. Ata' ix yal t'a heb': --Kananhek t'a tik. Ol b'at in lesalwok t'a chi', xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anb'at winhaj Pedro yet' chawanh heb' yuninal winhaj Zebedeo yet'ok. Ix och ijan Jesús skusi, ix och ilk'olal.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --Tzin te kusi, ijan wal tzin cham yuj kuselal. Kananhek t'a tik. Pitzanokab' ex wet'ok, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix snitzanb'at sb'a, ix em kuman ix emk'och snanhal sat t'a sat lu'um. Ix lesalwi icha tik: --Mamin, tato syala', ik'ek' jun yaelal tik t'a wib'anh. Palta mokab' ichok in gana a in tik, palta ichokab' wal a gana, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och t'a heb' winh oxwanh chi', palta ix yilani, waynak heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a winhaj Pedro: --¿Tom max yal pitzan ex junok hora wet'ok?
Hak'ek el he wayanh. Lesalwanhek, yik manh ol ex telwok ayik tzex montajb'at t'a chukal. Ha ko pensar, tek'an toni, palta haxo ko niwanil, malaj yip, xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi lesal, ix yalan icha tik: --Mamin, tato max yal yek' jun yaelal tik t'a wib'anh, elokab'k'och tas nab'il uuj, xchi.
Axo ix k'ochxi junelxo, ix yilani anheja' waynak heb' sk'ayb'um chi', yujto max techaj wayanh yuj heb'.
Yuj chi' ix kanxi heb' yuj. Ix b'at lesalwixi t'a yoxelal. Ix yalanxi icha ix yutej yalan t'a sb'ab'elal.

Axo ix k'ochxi t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi', ix yalan t'a heb': --¿Tom anheja' waynak ex? ¿Tom tonhej tzeyik' eyip? Ha tiknaik, a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ix k'och yorail wak'jioch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh chuk.
Q'ueanhek waan, koyek, yujto lak'anxo ayek' winh ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool, xchi t'a heb' winh.

Wanto yalani, ix jawi winhaj Judas. Ha winh chi' niwanok ayoch stz'akub'ok heb' uxluchwanh schekab' Jesús chi'. Tzijtum anima ix k'och yet' winh. Yet'nak yespada heb' yet' te te'. Ha heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio t'a skal heb' israel chi' ix chekankot heb'.

Ha winhaj Judas chi', winh ol ak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' heb', toxo ix slajtiej sb'a winh yet' heb'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha winh ol in tz'ub'elta sti', haton winh chi' tzeyama', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Yuj chi', elanhchamel ix k'och winh t'a Jesús. Ix yalan winh t'ay: --Buenas noches, ach in k'ayb'umal, xchi winh t'ay. Ixlajwi chi', ix stz'ub'anelta sti' winh.
--Ach wamigo, k'ulej tas tzul a k'ulok chi' t'a tik, xchi t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och umnaj heb' winh t'ay. Ix syaman heb' winh. Ix stzek'an heb' winh.
Palta ay jun winh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' ix ik'ank'eta k'een yespada. Ix stzepanel schikin jun winh schekab' winh sat sakerdote.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a winh sk'ayb'um chi': --Ak'xiem k'een espada chi' t'a yol yatut, yujto a heb' tz'ak'an owal yet' k'een espada, ol champax heb' yuj k'een.
¿Tom manh ojtakok, tato in gana tzin k'ankot t'a Dios, haton in Mam, ek'to t'a 72 mil heb' ángel ol yak'kot in skol t'a elanhchamel?
Palta tato ol in k'ankoti, manh ol elk'ochlaj tas tz'ib'yajkan t'a Slolonel Dios, yujto tz'ib'yajkani to yowalil icha tik ol in ajok, xchi Jesús.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanpax t'a heb' winh ix k'och chi': --¿Tom yajal in t'a skal heb' tz'ak'an owal yet' heb' yajal tzeyila', yuj chi' eyet' eyespada yet' he te', tzex ja in eyama'? Junjun k'u tzex in k'ayb'an t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios, palta maj in eyam ta'.
Palta icha ton tik ol aj yelk'och tas tz'ib'yajkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a Slolonel, xchi t'a heb' winh. Ix aktajkan yuj heb' sk'ayb'um chi' sch'okoj. Ix b'at heb' elelal smasanil.
Ha heb' winh ix yaman Jesús, ix yik'b'at heb' winh t'a winhaj Caifás, haton winh sat sakerdote. Ata' ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio.
Axo winhaj Pedro, najat tzak'anto sb'at winh yuj. Ix ochk'och winh t'a yamaq'uil spat winh sat yaj t'a heb' winh chi'. Ix em k'ojan winh yet' heb' winh polenkía, yik syilan winh tas ol ajok.
Axo heb' winh sat sakerdote, heb' winh ichamtak winak yet' masanil heb' winh sat yajal, ix say juntzanh winak heb' winh, yik syak'och es heb' t'a yib'anh Jesús chi' yik tz'och chamel t'a yib'anh.

Manh jantakok heb' ix k'ochi. Ix yak'anoch juntzanh es heb' t'a yib'anh. Palta malaj junok heb' ix elk'och tas ix yala'. k'ojank'olal to ix k'e wan chawanhxo winak chi', ix yak'an wal och es heb' t'a yib'anh.
Ix yalan heb': --Ix kab' yalani: Ha in tik, syal in satanel stemplo Dios, haxo t'a schab'jial tzin b'oanxik'ei, xchi, xchi heb'.
Axo winh sat sakerdote, ix k'e waan, ix yalan winh t'a Jesús: --¿Tom max ach tak'wi jab'ok? ¿Tom max ab' juntzanh syak'och heb' winh tik t'a ib'anh? xchi winh t'ay.
Axo Jesús tz'innhej xchi. Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh t'ay: --Al t'ayonh, tato Cristo ach, tato Yuninal ach Dios. Yowalil tzal t'a sat Dios pitzan, tato yel tzala', xchi winh t'ay.

--Ha in ton tik, icha tzal chi'. Swalanpax t'ayex, a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ol in eyila', k'ojan in em t'a swach' k'ab' Dios, haton Jun niwan spoder. Ol eyilpax wemul t'a skal asun t'a satcha'anh, xchi Jesús t'a winh.

Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winh sat sakerdote chi', ix snhik'chitan spichul winh skot yowal. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' yetyajalil chi': --Ha jun winh tik sb'uchwaj winh t'a Dios. ¿Tasto tz'och testigo sko saya'? Toxo ix kab' sb'uchwaj winh.
¿Tas xe chi yuj winh tiknaik? xchi winh. --Ix och smul winh. Smoj scham winh, xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix tzub'aj sat Jesús chi' yuj heb'. Ix t'ob'jib'at sti', ay pax heb' ix tz'itanb'at sat.
Ix yalan heb' t'ay: --Ha ach niwanok tzach alnax Cristoal tik, ala' mach tzach mak'ani, xchi heb' t'ay.
Axo winhaj Pedro, k'ojanek' winh t'a yamaq'uil jun pat chi'. Ix k'och jun ix kriada t'a winh. --Ha ach tik, etb'eyum a b'a yet' Jesús aj Nazaret tik, xchi ix t'a winh.
Palta ix yik'el winh t'a yib'anh t'a yichanh heb' smasanil: --Ha jun tzal tik, manh wojtakoklaj, xchi winh t'a ix.
Axo yik ix elta winhaj Pedro chi' t'a sti' spuertail amak', ix ilji winh yuj junxo ix. --Haton jun winh tik, yetb'eyum sb'a yet' Jesús aj Nazaret tik, xchi ix.
Palta ix yik'anxiel winh t'a yib'anh. Ix slokan sb'i Dios winh: --Manh wojtakoklaj jun winh tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Junanto rato chi', ix k'och heb' aytaxon ek' ta' t'a winhaj Pedro chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winh: --Wal yel, etb'eyum a b'a yet' heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús tik, yujto lajan a lolon yet' heb' skab'i, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi', ix sk'anankot yowal sk'ool Dios winh t'a yib'anh. Ix slokan sb'i Dios winh: --Ha jun winh tik, manh wojtakoklaj winh, xchi winh t'a heb'. Wan to yalan jun chi' winh, ix ok' nok' kaxlanh.

Yuj chi', ix snaankot winh tas ix yal Jesús, ayik ix yalan icha tik: Ayik mantzak ok' nok' kaxlanh, oxel ol ik'el t'a ib'anh to manh in ojtakok, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix sb'esanelta sb'a winhaj Pedro chi', ix te ok' winh sik'lab'il.
